issues.jp_before: 会社[かいしゃ]は社員[しゃいん]に毎年[まいとし]健康診断[けんこうしんだん]を{受[う]けさせます|pt-causative}。
issues.problem: Distractor 受けてもらいます is natural and also fits 'has its employees take a health check'.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 受けられます.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どものころ、父[ちち]に毎朝[まいあさ]ふとんを{畳[たた]まされた/畳[たた]ませられた|pt-causative}。
issues.problem: English had a dangling modifier ('As a child, my father...').
issues.action: English changed to 'When I was a child, my father made me...'.

issues.jp_before: 取引先[とりひきさき]の前[まえ]で、部長[ぶちょう]に{謝[あやま]らされた|pt-causative}。
issues.problem: 謝らせられた is an equally valid causative-passive; why wrongly claimed only the short form works.
issues.action: Added 謝らせられた as alternative and corrected why.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]に頼[たの]んで、自分[じぶん]のお金[かね]で好[す]きな自転車[じてんしゃ]を{買[か]わせてもらった|pt-sasete}。
issues.problem: English 'I asked my father to let me buy' misses that permission was granted (もらった).
issues.action: English changed to 'I asked my father, and he let me buy...'.

issues.jp_before: お願[ねが]い、もう少[すこ]し{寝[ね]かせて|pt-sasete}。
issues.problem: 寝させて is equally natural for 'let me sleep'.
issues.action: Added 寝させて as alternative.

issues.jp_before: 部長[ぶちょう]に頼[たの]んで、来月[らいげつ]の出張[しゅっちょう]に私[わたし]も{行[い]かせてもらう|pt-sasete}ことにした。
issues.problem: English 'decided to be allowed to go' was unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'I asked the manager, and I have arranged to be allowed to go on next month's business trip too.'

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]のおかげで、あの有名[ゆうめい]なレストランで{働[はたら]かせてもらっている|pt-sasete}。
issues.problem: English 'I am being allowed to work' was awkward.
issues.action: English changed to 'Thanks to my friend, I get to work at that famous restaurant.'
